title: Cham Islands in a day
budget: 70,000 VND visit fee. The boat is check on arrival.
summary: The morning boats leave Cửa Đại for Hòn Lao. Walk to Hải Tạng if the return will wait, and eat the catch in Bãi Làng. The visit fee is 70,000 VND a person from 10 June 2026, and the boat is separate.

stops.name: Bai Lang
stops.note: Land at Bãi Làng and pay the 70,000 VND reserve visit fee, which does not include the boat.

approach.note: Take the boat from the Cửa Đại pier, where passengers gather from 08:00 and the crowd runs through 10:00.

stops.name: Hai Tang Pagoda
stops.note: Walk up to Hải Tạng if the boat will still be there when you come down.

approach.note: Walk through the hamlet from Bãi Làng to Xóm Cấm.

stops.name: Canh ca
stops.note: Eat the fish soup with rice in Bãi Làng, with lunch around 11:00–12:00.

seoTitle: Cham Islands in a day — boat from Cửa Đại
seoDescription: A landing day on Hòn Lao from the Cửa Đại pier: Bãi Làng, Hải Tạng, and the catch. The visit fee is 70,000 VND from 10 June 2026.
